home.heroLead: Replace paper registers with an easy digital platform. Record daily morning & evening milk collection, calculate FAT and SNF rates instantly, and generate monthly farmer payment reports.
home.featuresTitle: Everything You Need for Your Dairy Center
home.featuresSubtitle: Designed for dairy owners and collection centers to manage daily operations smoothly without paperwork.
home.featCollectionDesc: Record morning and evening milk entries by farmer tag number with quick quantity entry.
home.featFarmerDesc: Keep an organized list of all registered farmers, their unique tag numbers, and contact details.
home.featBillingDesc: Calculate exact payout rates based on milk quantity, FAT %, and SNF % automatically.
home.featMultiRoleDesc: Separate simple views for Dairy Owners, Center Managers, and Individual Farmers.
home.featBilingualDesc: Switch language anytime between English and Nepali with a single click.
home.featSecurityDesc: Your dairy records are safely stored with password protection and quick link recovery.
home.workflowSubtitle: 4 simple steps to manage your dairy collection digitally.
home.step1Desc: Create your dairy account and set your standard milk rate formulas for FAT and SNF.
home.step2Desc: Register your local farmers and assign unique tag numbers for fast daily entry.
home.step3Desc: Enter milk liters, FAT %, and SNF % during morning and evening collection.
home.step4Desc: Create total monthly milk summary statements and complete farmer payments accurately.
home.rolesTitle: Built for Everyone in the Dairy Business
home.rolesSubtitle: Clear, easy-to-use tools tailored for dairy owners, collection centers, and farmers.
home.roleAdminDesc: Save hours of manual book-keeping every month and eliminate calculation mistakes.
home.roleSuperDesc: Manage multiple collection centers from one place and view total milk collection trends.
home.roleFarmerDesc: Get clear, transparent milk records, quality rate breakdowns, and timely payouts.
home.faqSubtitle: Simple answers to common questions about using DairyConnect.
home.faq1Q: Can I use DairyConnect on my smartphone?
home.faq1A: Yes, DairyConnect works on smartphones, tablets, and computers. You can record milk entries directly from your mobile phone.
home.faq2Q: How does the system calculate milk prices?
home.faq2A: The system automatically multiplies the milk volume by your rate formula based on FAT and SNF percentages.
home.faq3Q: Can I switch the app to Nepali language?
home.faq3A: Yes! You can switch between English and Nepali at any time by clicking the language button at the top.
home.faq4Q: What if I forget my account password?
home.faq4A: You can click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your email, and receive a secure password reset link directly in your email inbox.
home.ctaTitle: Start Managing Your Dairy Digitally Today
home.ctaSubtitle: Simplify your milk collection, quality checks, and farmer payouts.
home.footerDesc: Simple and reliable software for dairy farm milk collection and farmer payment management.
